Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a refined, professional French APSI BTP homepage redesign mockup optimized for LARGE desktop monitors. The attached four screenshots are reference images showing the existing site at different viewport sizes. Preserve the real APSI arch logo, Montserrat/Inter typography, navy #061733, blue #0067d6, white backgrounds, natural crane and modern construction photo at RIGHT, pale-blue angular diagonal photo border, original content and blue footer. These are visual reference screenshots, NOT exact compositions to copy. Correct the current cramped fixed-width center column and huge empty white space at high resolutions: use a wide responsive composition occupying about 88–92% of the viewport width, a taller hero proportional to the viewport, prominent readable typography, deliberate spacing, and footer at the BOTTOM of the viewport with no blank white area underneath. Main three service cards must be fully visible, not clipped; all text is legible and aligned. Never stretch a tiny existing webpage screenshot. Rebuild the graphic composition at native high fidelity, confident architectural editorial art direction, not a SaaS template. Retain generous intentional breathing room without wasted lower half. Output one single 16:9 flat webpage screenshot, no browser/devtools chrome, rulers, monitor or device mockup, resolution labels or outside presentation framing. Keep factual content exactly; no invented statistics or extra service offerings.
Header: logo left, QUI SOMMES-NOUS, NOS MÉTIERS, NOS RÉFÉRENCES, NOS CLIENTS, and Nous contacter arrow button at rightmost edge of the header.
Hero quote verbatim in navy: De tous les actes, / le plus complet / est celui de construire. Author Paul Valéry in smaller serif. Blue button Découvrir nos références with arrow.
Three services in equal columns with blue outline icons: COORDINATION DE CHANTIER — Organisation des interventions et coordination des entreprises.; PLANIFICATION DES TRAVAUX — Suivi des délais, phasage et anticipation des contraintes d’exécution.; SUIVI OPÉRATIONNEL — Présence terrain, dialogue constant et suivi du chantier jusqu’à la livraison.
Full-width blue footer includes white architectural crane line drawing at left, APSI BTP / Coordination de travaux, 84750 Caseneuve / info@apsi-btp.fr, Mentions légales / Politique de confidentialité. Keep it compact and aligned with main content. No thin horizontal decorative line extending from the photo across the left white background.
